{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection1",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedFormattersAndResolvers_HaveExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestNamespace\n{\n    public enum MyEnum\n    {\n        Alpha = 0,\n        Beta = 1,\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class IntKeyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public MyEnum Kind { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(2)]\n        public IMyUnion UnionValue { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public class StringKeyObject\n    {\n        public string Name { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [Union(0, typeof(UnionCaseA))]\n    [Union(1, typeof(UnionCaseB))]\n    public interface IMyUnion\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionCaseA : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionCaseB : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string Label { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        MetadataReference[] references = net80Refs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        HashSet<SyntaxTree> generatedTrees = runResult.Results\n            .SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources)\n            .Select(s => s.SyntaxTree)\n            .ToHashSet();\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.IFormatterResolver\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterface);\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverInterface);\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> generatedTypes = new List<INamedTypeSymbol>();\n        CollectNamedTypes(output.Assembly.GlobalNamespace, generatedTrees, generatedTypes);\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> formatters = generatedTypes\n            .Where(t => t.AllInterfaces.Any(i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i.OriginalDefinition, formatterInterface)))\n            .ToList();\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> resolvers = generatedTypes\n            .Where(t => t.AllInterfaces.Any(i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i, resolverInterface)))\n            .ToList();\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? intKeyType = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.IntKeyObject\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? stringKeyType = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.StringKeyObject\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? enumType = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.MyEnum\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? unionType = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.IMyUnion\");\n\n        Assert.NotNull(intKeyType);\n        Assert.NotNull(stringKeyType);\n        Assert.NotNull(enumType);\n        Assert.NotNull(unionType);\n\n        Assert.Contains(formatters, f => ImplementsFormatterFor(f, formatterInterface!, intKeyType!));\n        Assert.Contains(formatters, f => ImplementsFormatterFor(f, formatterInterface!, stringKeyType!));\n        Assert.Contains(formatters, f => ImplementsFormatterFor(f, formatterInterface!, enumType!));\n        Assert.Contains(formatters, f => ImplementsFormatterFor(f, formatterInterface!, unionType!));\n        Assert.NotEmpty(resolvers);\n\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol generatedType in formatters.Concat(resolvers))\n        {\n            bool hasExcludeAttr = generatedType.GetAttributes()\n                .Any(a => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n            Assert.True(hasExcludeAttr, $\"Generated type '{generatedType.ToDisplayString()}' does not have [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static bool ImplementsFormatterFor(INamedTypeSymbol candidate, INamedTypeSymbol formatterInterface, INamedTypeSymbol targetType)\n    {\n        return candidate.AllInterfaces.Any(i =>\n            SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i.OriginalDefinition, formatterInterface) &&\n            i.TypeArguments.Length == 1 &&\n            SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i.TypeArguments[0], targetType));\n    }\n\n    private static void CollectNamedTypes(INamespaceOrTypeSymbol container, HashSet<SyntaxTree> generatedTrees, List<INamedTypeSymbol> results)\n    {\n        foreach (ISymbol member in container.GetMembers())\n        {\n            if (member is INamespaceSymbol ns)\n            {\n                CollectNamedTypes(ns, generatedTrees, results);\n            }\n            else if (member is INamedTypeSymbol type)\n            {\n                if (type.DeclaringSyntaxReferences.Any(r => generatedTrees.Contains(r.SyntaxTree)))\n                {\n                    results.Add(type);\n                }\n\n                CollectNamedTypes(type, generatedTrees, results);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}
